packageIdentity: Bind the package to the full audit commit when committed. This manifest verifies the prepared file bytes and does not claim a future commit SHA.

reviewScope.lineCountingMethod: Physical lines with Solidity strings retained and line/block comments removed; excludes blank lines, includes declarations, braces and imports.

areas: scripts/ except retained coverage, inventory, EIP-1153 probe and offline reference tools
superseded audit inventories and verification records
deployment environment example, TypeScript config and product issue template
ancillaryExclusions.evidenceOwner: Original evidence and deployment programs remain byte-for-byte in the pinned release base.

artifactHashEncoding.bytecode: SHA-256 of compiled creation/runtime bytes before immutable substitution; metadata disabled.
artifactHashEncoding.abi: SHA-256 of ABI JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators; array order preserved.

compilerContext.reason: Retain release compiler context after excluding the Merkle provider. Removing this input changes compiler-generated IDs and lens optimizer output under Solidity 0.8.25. The canonical full test build matches the release artifacts; arbitrary narrowed input graphs are not guaranteed to do so.
